variables.name: family.sans
variables.description: Anek Latin. Every non-code level: display, h1, h2, h3, body, body-sm, caption. CoForge is single-family for prose (brand.md §4).

variables.name: family.mono
variables.description: Code and token values. Source Code Pro, selected on measurement [ART-007 § Optical pairing] — its x-height ratio is 0.486 against Anek Latin's 0.488, a 0.4% difference. Inline code sits inside body text, so a mismatched x-height reads as a size change mid-sentence and invites a compensating size nudge that then breaks alignment in tables. The nearest rival was 14x further off. Not a brand gesture — a face chosen to be unnoticeable next to the one that is.

variables.name: black.default-a00
variables.description: black.default at 0 alpha. MINTED 2026-09-01 to repair C-021 — Carbon's alpha was transcribed into an extension and applied by nothing, leaving 53 semantic tokens fully opaque since the first token commit. DTCG has no alias-with-modifier, and the semantic layer may hold no literals, so the alpha has to live on a primitive. hex carries the alpha byte: a 6-digit hex beside an alpha field contradicts itself, and two consumers here read hex and never look at alpha.
